methods.label: Raw
methods.description: Served uncooked.

methods.label: Boiled
methods.description: Cooked submerged in boiling water or stock.

methods.label: Steamed
methods.description: Cooked over boiling water, not in it.

methods.label: Poached
methods.description: Cooked gently in liquid below boiling.

methods.label: Grilled
methods.description: Cooked over direct radiant heat on a grill.

methods.label: Broiled
methods.description: Cooked under direct overhead heat.

methods.label: Roasted
methods.description: Cooked uncovered in dry oven heat.

methods.label: Baked
methods.description: Cooked in an oven, often in a dish.

methods.label: Air-fried
methods.description: Cooked in circulating hot air with little or no oil.

methods.label: Pan-seared
methods.description: Cooked briefly in a hot pan with a little fat to brown the surface.

methods.label: Sautéed
methods.description: Cooked quickly in a little fat over high heat, tossed.

methods.label: Stir-fried
methods.description: Cooked quickly in a very hot wok with a little oil, stirred constantly.

methods.label: Shallow-fried
methods.description: Cooked in a layer of oil that comes partway up the food.

methods.label: Deep-fried
methods.description: Cooked submerged in hot oil.

methods.label: Breaded and baked
methods.description: Coated in crumbs or flour and cooked in the oven.

methods.label: Breaded and fried
methods.description: Coated in crumbs, flour or batter and fried in oil.

methods.label: Braised
methods.description: Browned, then cooked slowly covered in a little liquid.

methods.label: Stewed
methods.description: Cooked slowly in liquid that is served with it.

methods.label: Slow-cooked
methods.description: Cooked for hours at low temperature in liquid.

methods.label: Pressure-cooked
methods.description: Cooked in liquid under pressure.

methods.label: Smoked
methods.description: Cooked or flavoured in smoke.

methods.label: Blended
methods.description: Puréed or blended uncooked.

methods.label: Marinated (raw)
methods.description: Cured or dressed in acid or salt without heat, e.g. ceviche.
